threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: Livit Jotform confirmation emails render dates as mm/dd/yy instead of the international dd/mm/yy format, and preferred scan time is not a required field so confirmations default to 12am.
threads.note: Both defects are logged on COP-2019; blocked on the call of whether to patch the legacy Livit form now or fold the fix into the on-contract migration — decision sits with Ricardo and Snehal. Stephenie is manually correcting formats in the meantime.

threads.author: Juyoung Jang
threads.summary: Capture techs cannot see Airbnb jobs in their CT Airtable views even after the job has been scheduled, so job details have to be passed over by hand.
threads.note: Juyoung said on 8/11 at 9:20 PM she would check with the CTs and share specific job links; nothing received since, so the next action is hers before COP-2043 can be narrowed further.
